visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: One Zero Goes Missing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Moving the zeros of [0,1,0,3,12] should give [1,3,12,0,0], but the program prints [1,3,12,0].

solution.explanation: Two zeros were removed, so two must be added back. The loop runs from 0 up to but not including zeros, so the condition must be i < zeros; subtracting 1 loses one zero.
